name: dora-graph-lens
description: Inline knowledge-graph view for functions and classes. Hover a symbol for its subgraph stats, then open callers/callees/co-changes/history in a panel docked beside your code.

doraGraphLens.serverUrl.description: Base URL of the graphdb MCP/HTTP server (graph_mcp_server.py). The extension auto-launches it if unreachable and autoStart is enabled.

doraGraphLens.repoName.description: Repo name used to construct graph node ids (e.g. 'amo', 'dograh'). Empty = derive from workspace folder name.

doraGraphLens.repoRoot.description: Path (relative to the workspace folder) where the ingested repo lives, e.g. 'dograh'. Empty = auto-detect (workspace root, then a folder named like repoName).

doraGraphLens.autoStartServer.description: Launch the graphdb server (python tools/graph_mcp_server.py) automatically when the extension activates and the port is unreachable.

doraGraphLens.graphdbDir.description: Absolute path to the graphdb repo containing tools/graph_mcp_server.py. Empty = auto-detect from workspace.

doraGraphLens.hoverEnabled.description: Show the inline graph summary card on hover.

doraGraphLens.codeLensEnabled.description: Show a graph stats CodeLens line above functions and classes.

doraGraphLens.defaultDepth.description: Default blast-radius depth for caller/callee views.
